title: Rabbi Ilfai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 2:2: a woman lit coals beneath Rabbi Ilfai’s house, and he wished to protest; the case came before Rabbi Nasa, who said, “They did not say,” etc. (Hyman notes that Rabbi Nasa belonged to the fourth generation of Palestinian Amoraim.) But Yuchasin’s reading is “before Rav Assi.” In Kohelet Rabbah 1:3: Rabbi Huna and Rabbi Acha in the name of Rabbi Chilfai.

notes.text: The Palestinian generation statement is Hyman’s. The saved Torat Emet Kohelet Rabbah 1:3 connected passage fully writes Rabbi Huna and Rabbi Acha in Rabbi Chilfai’s name, supporting this occurrence’s contextual expansion. The long whole scalar was hash-bound; only its connected relevant context was read.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 2:2 places the smoke case before Rabbi Nasa. The exact Yuchasin Assi reading and Hyman’s generation assignment remain attributed, without merging Nasa and Assi.
